caption: The drawing depicts a single green parasol placed against a plain, light beige background. The parasol has a richly detailed canopy made up of several panels in varying shades of green, with multiple layers of ruffled, textured fabric trim along the outer and inner edges. The ribs of the parasol are faintly visible beneath the fabric. Attached to the top of the parasol is a dark green or black ribbon, looped and hanging down. The handle of the parasol is elongated, cylindrical, and covered in a woven or carved pattern, rendered in a brown hue, with a rounded end. There are no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Sunshade
